about: READ-ONLY — plan one oldest eligible active client backend older than 15 minutes in the protected jobs API's actual database on boss/postgres-0. Its address must be in a declared cluster Pod CIDR, non-loopback/non-link-local, and absent from complete cluster-wide live Pod and node address censuses. The exact approved plan names selected one and every deferred original candidate; another approval is required for the next. Retains native target, server lifetime and exact session identities. Native reads have a fixed strict per-call cap; measured transport calibration is not a promise that this census will finish. Ownership checks are not a cross-resource lock against later IP reuse.
